required_outcomes: Reads the resent invoice (Meadow Works MW-1184, dated 1 June 2025, call-out and first hour labour for cleaning and greasing the shower mixer, £75.00 plus £15.00 VAT, £90.00 total) and records it against the job.

Replies to Kendall that Meadow Works attended on Sunday 1 June, found a temperature fault in the mixer, cleaned and greased it and report hot and cold both running, and that invoice MW-1184 is £90.00 including VAT, sending or attaching the invoice so he can arrange payment.
Asks Ava to confirm that both the hot and cold sides of the shower are now working before the job is treated as complete.
acceptable_alternatives: Arranging for the agency to pay Meadow Works from the landlord's funds instead of Kendall paying directly, provided Kendall is told the amount and what it covers.
Keeping the request open on hold for the tenant's confirmation with a short follow-up date rather than closing it now.
Asking Meadow Works to send the photos by WhatsApp for the file, as long as the landlord's answer and payment do not wait on them.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the invoice matches the work Meadow Works described on 1 June (a call-out and cleaning, no parts), so nothing needs querying.
Records that the photos have not been received and says nothing about what they show.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or holding the invoice when it matches the reported work and the landlord has asked to pay.
Telling Kendall the amount is still unknown or that the invoice has not arrived.
Closing the request before the tenant has confirmed the shower works.
prohibited_actions: Approving or stating any amount other than the £90.00 (£75.00 plus VAT) on the invoice.
Describing the contents of photos that were never received.
critical_failures: Giving Kendall an invoice amount or invoice details that differ from the attached invoice, or describing photos that are not in the record.
